app.name: Membase
app.description: Persistent memory for ChatGPT using MCP — search, store, wiki, and cross-session handoffs

justifications.read_only_justification: Tool modifies local plugin credentials and configuration state during OAuth flow.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tool initiates external OAuth authentication with membase.so, establishing connection to external API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool is non-destructive; it stores credentials and settings without deleting existing data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Tool deletes local OAuth tokens and resets plugin configuration.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tool only operates on local plugin state; no external world access.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool is non-destructive; it clears local credentials without affecting cloud data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Tool retrieves current plugin state and configuration; no modifications.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tool only queries local plugin state and optional profile from authenticated API.

justifications.read_only_justification: Tool modifies local project scoping configuration (auto/manual/off mode).
justifications.open_world_justification: Tool only operates on local plugin configuration; constrained to predefined config modes.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool is non-destructive; it updates settings without deleting data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Tool creates and stores new long-term memories in Membase backend.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tool only operates on user's private Membase memory; no public internet state change.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool is non-destructive; it appends new memories without modifying existing data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Tool creates or replaces the current handoff summary for a project.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tool accepts arbitrary user-provided handoff content in any language.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool destructively replaces any older handoff for the same project (keeps exactly one per project).

justifications.read_only_justification: Tool searches and retrieves memories without modification.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tool only queries user's private Membase memory; no public internet state change.

justifications.read_only_justification: Tool returns the current date/time in the user's Membase timezone and UTC; no state modification.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tool computes the time server-side for the authenticated user; no external world interaction.

justifications.read_only_justification: Tool searches and retrieves wiki documents without modification.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tool accepts optional collection filters; queries are constrained to user's wiki.

justifications.read_only_justification: Tool creates new wiki documents with user-provided title and content.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tool only stores content in user's private wiki; no external world state change.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool is non-destructive; it appends new documents without modifying existing wiki.

justifications.read_only_justification: Tool modifies existing wiki document title, content, or collection by ID.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tool requires specific document UUID; updates are constrained to user's wiki.
justifications.destructive_justification: Content updates replace the document body in place with no version history, so overwritten content is unrecoverable; flagged destructive accordingly.

justifications.read_only_justification: Tool deletes a wiki document by ID from permanent storage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Tool operates only within the user's private Membase wiki; no external world interaction.
justifications.destructive_justification: Tool permanently and irreversibly deletes wiki documents; flagged destructive so host clients can require user confirmation, and the tool description instructs the model to confirm with the user first.

positive.name: Authenticate and login
positive.description: User initiates OAuth login to connect Membase account
positive.expectedBehavior: OAuth flow completes, credentials saved locally, user profile fetched and returned with logged_in=true

positive.name: Search personal memories by semantic query
positive.description: User searches for previous project decisions using natural language query
positive.expectedBehavior: Returns up to 20 relevant memories with summary, source, timestamp; includes hasMore flag if results exceed limit

positive.name: Store new long-term memory
positive.description: User saves architectural decision to persistent memory with optional project tag
positive.expectedBehavior: Memory sanitized (no secrets detected), stored in backend, confirmation returned with timestamp and project scope

positive.name: Create and update wiki document
positive.description: User adds factual documentation to wiki, then updates title and collection
positive.expectedBehavior: Document created with unique ID, update replaces the document content in place, both operations confirm success

positive.name: Store session handoff for cross-client continuation
positive.description: User saves ChatGPT session state (decisions, progress) as handoff for use in another IDE
positive.expectedBehavior: Handoff replaces any previous handoff for same project, status returned, replacement count shown if applicable

negative.name: Attempt to add memory with secret content
negative.description: User tries to store API key or password-like content
negative.expectedBehavior: Tool rejects content with 'Refusing to store content that looks like a secret' error; no partial storage occurs

negative.name: Delete wiki document with invalid ID
negative.description: User calls delete_wiki with a doc_id that does not exist or is not a valid UUID
negative.expectedBehavior: Tool returns an error and no document is deleted; the tool description instructs the model to confirm with the user before deleting

negative.name: Search memory when not logged in
negative.description: User calls search_memory without prior successful login
negative.expectedBehavior: Tool throws 'Membase is not connected. Run /membase:login first.'; graceful error with no state corruption

starterPrompts: Save this architectural decision to my memory: We're using event-driven patterns to handle 10k concurrent users
I'm back on the microservice project. What decisions did we make and what was I working on last?
Search my knowledge base for database scaling patterns I've documented before

compliance.dataHandling: OAuth-based authentication (no password storage), user data encrypted in transit via HTTPS, sensitive content redacted before persistence
securityConsiderations: HTTPS required for all API communication
No API keys stored locally in plaintext
Secrets detection filters content before storage
Destructive operations (delete_wiki, update_wiki, store_handoff) are flagged with destructiveHint=true so host clients can require user confirmation
All tools perform input sanitization and validate content length (50KB for memories, 100KB for wiki)

metadata.reviewNotes: All 12 MCP tools properly annotated with readOnlyHint, openWorldHint, destructiveHint. Justifications use required keys: read_only_justification, open_world_justification, destructive_justification. 5 positive + 3 negative test cases cover authentication, search, memory storage, wiki operations, handoff, and error scenarios. Tools match actual server.ts implementation. No tool exposes secrets or credentials in responses.
